per_step.command: mkdir -p /app/output/portfolios && jq -r '.[].id' /app/data/client_profiles.json > /tmp/client_ids.txt && while read id; do /usr/local/bin/generate_portfolio.sh "$id" > "/app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_${id}.json"; done < /tmp/client_ids.txt && rm /tmp/client_ids.txt && wc -l /tmp/client_ids.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "No clients or error"

mkdir -p /app/output/portfolios && jq -r '.[].id' /app/data/client_profiles.json | while read id; do /usr/local/bin/generate_portfolio.sh "$id" > "/app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_${id}.json"; /usr/local/bin/validate_portfolio_compliance.sh "/app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_${id}.json"; done && echo "All portfolios generated and validated" && ls /app/output/portfolios | wc -l

mkdir -p /app/output/portfolios && jq -r '.[].client_id' /app/data/client_profiles.json | while read id; do /usr/local/bin/generate_portfolio.sh "$id" > "/app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_${id}.json"; done && echo "All portfolios generated" && ls /app/output/portfolios | wc -l && echo "Now validating..." && for f in /app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_*.json; do /usr/local/bin/validate_portfolio_compliance.sh "$f"; done
